facts.value: For each passed examination, you will receive a digital language certificate indicating your language level according to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR), which is recognized by the International Office and Global Office of Goethe University. This certificate is issued in both German and English. You can use this language certificate for your application abroad or later during your job search.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Courses for all students: You will only know your grades after you receive your certificate via email, approximately 4 to 5 weeks after the exam date. Elective module courses and Master's Course: You can access your grades password-protected in QIS.
